'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Ukrainian Kharkiv counteroffensive]]
****The [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian military]] says that it has shot down an [[Iran]]ian [[HESA Shahed 136]] [[unmanned combat aerial vehicle|combat drone]] operated by [[Russia]] near [[Kupiansk]], [[Kharkiv Oblast]]. An inscription on the drone identified it as an "M214 Geran-2", which did not immediately correspond to known Russian weaponry. [https://abcnews.go.com/Technology/wireStory/ukraine-military-claims-downing-iran-drone-russia-89801492 (ABC News)]
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**[[Republican insurgency in Afghanistan]]
***[[Taliban]] authorities say that they have killed 40 [[National Resistance Front of Afghanistan|National Resistance Front]] fighters in the [[Panjshir Province]] of [[Afghanistan]], including four commanders. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-says-40-rebel-force-members-killed-northern-panjshir-2022-09-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]]
**[[September 2022 Armenia–Azerbaijan clashes]]
***[[Prime minister of Armenia|Armenian prime minister]] [[Nikol Pashinyan]] says that 49 [[Armed Forces of Armenia|soldiers]] were killed during overnight clashes with [[Azerbaijan]] after it [[shell (projectile)|shelled]] villages yesterday and that fighting was ongoing. [https://www.reuters.com/world/armenias-pm-says-49-soldiers-died-clashes-with-azerbaijan-2022-09-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**A roadside bombing in [[Swat District]], [[Pakistan]], kills eight people, including a local tribal leader known for his opposition to the [[Pakistani Taliban]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/anti-taliban-tribal-leader-among-5-killed-northwest-pakistan-bombing-2022-09-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Tigray War]]
**[[Ethiopia]]n [[airstrike]]s hit [[Mekelle University]]'s business campus and a [[Dimtsi Weyane]] radio station. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-717029 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
**The [[Tigray People's Liberation Front]] says that [[Eritrea]] has taken the town of [[Sheraro]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/9/13/air-strike-hits-capital-of-ethiopias-northern-tigray-region (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**Following the release of the [[Bureau of Labor Statistics]] [[United States Consumer Price Index|consumer price index]] for the month of August, all 30 stocks in the [[Dow Jones Industrial Average]] decrease in value, resulting in a 3.9% drop in the index. [https://theweek.com/stock-market/1016637/stock-market-takes-big-dip-following-august-inflation-report (''The Week'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**Six people are killed and five people are missing after a boat carrying migrants sinks off the coast of [[Turkey]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/least-six-dead-after-migrant-boat-sinks-off-turkish-coast-coastguard-2022-09-13/ (Reuters)]
*Five people are killed and 14 others are injured after a building collapsed in [[Amman]], [[Jordan]], 10 people are reported missing. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/9/13/residential-building-jordan-capital-amman-collapse (Al Jazeera)]
*Seventeen people are injured after a [[fuel tanker]] [[explode]]s in [[Sabha, Libya|Sabha]], [[Libya]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/libya-fuel-blast-injures-13-2022-09-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[President of Kazakhstan|Kazakh President]] [[Kassym-Jomart Tokayev]] agrees to change the name of [[Kazakhstan]]'s capital from "Nur-Sultan" back to "[[Astana]]". He had previously changed the capital's name in 2019 to honor his predecessor [[Nursultan Nazarbayev]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/sep/14/kazakhstan-to-change-name-of-capital-from-nur-sultan-back-to-astana (''The Guardian'')]
